title: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See
description: Kunon, a young man who cannot see, has the goal of creating new eyes with water magic. After just five months of learning sorcery, Kunon surpassed his own mentor and honed his talent as he tried to do a feat that’s never been done before. A fantasy about a young man, a blind genius, who opens up the world through curiosity in the pursuit for magic is about to begin.

episodes_data.title: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: As the descendant of the hero, Kunon Gurion was born blind, and he’s determined to make eyes using his magic.

episodes_data.title: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: When Kunon goes to the school for noble children to take exams, he encounters a challenge.

episodes_data.title: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Kunon graduates and Miss Jenie resigns. Kunon wants a Royal Sorcerer for his new teacher.

episodes_data.title: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Kunon goes to the castle to meet the Royal Sorcerers to be tested and meets Raysha, Mirika’s older sister.

episodes_data.title: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: After passing the test at the Black Tower, Kunon finally meets his new master.

episodes_data.title: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Studying under Zeonly, Kunon finally learns the skills he needs to make eyeballs.

episodes_data.title: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Kunon gains vision, but is he seeing more than he should? Then, he departs to the magic school.

episodes_data.title: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Kunon and Rinko, who took over as Kunon’s maid in place of Iko, finally arrive at Dirashik.

episodes_data.title: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Kunon takes the entrance exam with Professor Soff. At the interview, he meets a mysterious sorcerer.

episodes_data.title: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Kunon and Reyes work together to find a solution for Reyes’ financial problem.

episodes_data.title: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Kunon asks Hank to cook bacon and Riyah to fly. The three girls try to talk to Kunon but always miss him.

episodes_data.title: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Kunon gets recruited by all three factions. And his response…?

episodes_data.title: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: After Kunon passes the test and joins the three factions, he sets sail on the search for a shipwreck.
